findings.detail: D11 (NEW, and the coordinator ruled on it): a validator REFUSE disposition has its PRECONDITION verified before it is executed. composite_key findings #1 (18 blocks) and #2 (10 blocks) carry verdict CONFIRMED and build_disposition REFUSE against a defect THIS MAP NO LONGER HAS -- those views now key '{REQUIREMENTNAME}#{SEQUENCENO}' and '{DOCUMENTTYPE}', and both columns are present on them. Executing the REFUSE would have DELETED 28 correctly-keyed SAT_DOCUMENT_CHECKLIST blocks, unrecoverably at load. They are NOT refused; the staleness is reported. The other five dispositions are applied exactly as declared: 2 LIVE REFUSE (3 + 3 = 6 blocks), EMIT resolving hop direction from the graph, EMIT with the instability declared, EMIT BOTH without normalising. Nothing was re-keyed in either direction.

D1-REFDECODE-DEFAULT-REFUSE -- The reference_decode gate defaults to REFUSING the row. No reference-decode master exists anywhere in this bundle, and the directive says loading the raw code into a label attribute is WRONG DATA that every gate passes. COST: 3 rows (SAT_PARTY_ORGANISATION_PROFILE 'Industry Description' and SAT_PARTY_IDENTIFICATION 'Insurance Repository Name' x2) emit NULL and are counted as refused rather than carrying a code where a label belongs. If a decode master is in fact available, 3 label attributes stay empty until the var is flipped. OVERRULE: Set dbt var mxh3_reference_decode_available to true (one line in dbt_project.yml), or pass --vars on the run.

D2-REFDECODE-SCOPE-IS-THE-DIRECTIVE -- The reference_decode GATE is scoped to the 3 blocks carrying build_directive, NOT to all 59 blocks whose transformation_kind is 'reference_decode'. The directive population is defined by the directive field; transformation_kind is a description of the mapping, not an instruction. COST: 56 blocks assert a code->decode transformation and are built WITHOUT the gate, so they load the mapped value as-is. If the mapper intended all 59 to be gated, 56 label attributes receive coded values. This is why the figure is reported with BOTH matchers rather than one. OVERRULE: Set REFDECODE_SCOPE = 'transformation_kind' in this module.

D3-QUARANTINE-RENAMES-THE-UNSTABLE-LEG -- The 45 surrogate-backed child-key components are emitted in the quarantine layer under a column named <LEG>__UNSTABLE_SURROGATE, NOT under the model's declared child-key column, and the quarantine models are emitted disabled. A column that is not spelled like the declared child key cannot be wired into a satellite by accident. COST: The 7 ratified Multi-Active SCD2 satellites carry NO history from these 45 blocks. That loss is deliberate and visible in the emitted SQL; it is not a source gap and must not be reported as one. OVERRULE: Set QUARANTINE_EMIT_DECLARED_NAME = True in this module -- which re-enables the duplicate-row defect the directive exists to prevent.

D4-EMI-HOME-IS-THE-RATIFIED-SATELLITE -- 'Last EMI Paid Date' and 'Outstanding Loan Amount' are built ONLY on the ratified SAT_CLAIM_BENEFIT_HEAD and suppressed on OPUS's placeholder SAT_CLAIM_COVER_SECTION_ASSESSMENT, which is absent from data_7.js entirely. Where data_7.js speaks, the model wins. COST: Splits a coherent 23-column OPUS assessment block for 2 columns of overlap; the remaining 21 columns stay on the placeholder and the block must be reassembled by hand to be read as a whole. Cheap to reverse -- it is an attribute routing entry, not a key. OVERRULE: Remove the 2 entries from ATTRIBUTE_ROUTING_SUPPRESS in this module.

D5-TRANSITION-IS-BUILD-SIDE -- SAT_CLAIM_STATUS_TRANSITION is ABSENT from data_7.js, so it is built on the augmented (unratified) track as a multi-active satellite with the caller-ratified child key 'Status Code | Transition Date' and a union of SEVEN attributes -- 'Transition Actor User Reference' and 'Transition Performed By Reference' are ONE fact fed from both sides, not two. COST: If the two names are in fact different facts, one column carries two meanings and separating them later is a satellite re-grain. The directive states they are the same fact; this build follows it. OVERRULE: Remove the pair from ATTRIBUTE_UNION_ALIASES in this module.

D6-CROSS-VALUE-ONLY-WHEN-UNIQUE -- A '>>' / LCA cross descends into another branch and can match N rows per source row. The resolver exposes the crossed value ONLY when it matches exactly one row, and always exposes the match COUNT beside it; rows with N>1 are diverted to the reject log. COST: Where a cross is genuinely 1:N the value is NULL rather than an arbitrary pick, so those rows lose the key and are counted as rejects instead of silently keeping one branch's value. A fallback that guesses converts a loud gap into a silent corruption, which is why the NULL is preferred. OVERRULE: Set CROSS_REQUIRE_UNIQUE = False in this module (restores arbitrary pick semantics -- not recommended).

D7-UNRESOLVED-KEYS-GET-NO-KEY -- The 16 VIEW_COLLECTIONS_ADDITIONAL_DETAILS blocks whose resolved_key tier is 'unresolved' and which carry no expression are built with NO key: every row is diverted to the reject log carrying the declared source gap. Three candidate keys were considered and rejected by the mapper; inventing a fourth is not the builder's call (s5.7). COST: HUB_FINANCIAL_TRANSACTION receives nothing from that view, and 16 columns reach no satellite. Visible as a counted reject, not as an absent model. OVERRULE: Supply an expression in the map; this build will not synthesise one.

D8-COVERGRAIN-BUILT-WITH-A-FANOUT-COUNT -- SRM-COVERGRAIN's 35 blocks on 2 views are BUILT as mapped (s5.7 -- the builder does not correct the mapping), with a per-anchor row count emitted beside the key so an N>1 fan-in is counted and diverted rather than silently keeping one arbitrary cover's values. COST: If the N rows per claim do carry differing values, those rows are rejected rather than loaded, so the satellite is EMPTY for those claims instead of wrong. Needs executed data to settle; invisible to check_collapse either way. OVERRULE: Set COVERGRAIN_DIVERT_FANOUT = False in this module.

D9-MEMBERSHIP-RE-DERIVED-NOT-TRUSTED -- resolved_on_view is NOT trusted. Membership is re-derived per row against the row's OWN view from 00_tables_index.json, and a brace token is read as a COALESCE LADDER of alternatives: a rung absent from the view is pruned, and only a leg with NO surviving rung is refused. COST: Under this matcher 1 component disagrees with its own flag: SAT_POLICY_COVERAGE_SCHEDULE 'Coverage Reference' = '{ADDEDCOVERS element}' on MEMBERS_MEMBER_DETAILS_PIVOT_VW, whose token contains a SPACE and so names no column. That block is REFUSED, not renamed. A ladder-blind matcher would instead have accused 246 components. OVERRULE: Set TRUST_RESOLVED_ON_VIEW = True in this module -- which emits a column that does not exist.

D10-SPINE-DISPLAY-RUNG-RESOLVED-FROM-THE-GRAPH -- A 'spine:<TABLE>.<COLUMN>' rung inside a child-key value is DISPLAY ONLY and is never parsed as SQL. The displayed form names the CONCEPT; the mechanism is re-derived from the graph. All 199 occurrences name MEMBERS_PARTY.PARTY_CODE, which the graph shows is a SIBLING of the row's view in 198 of 199 cases -- so these are LCA crosses, not climbs. COST: The one remaining form, 'spine:ROLE' on SAT_LNK_POLICY_PARTY_ROLE, names no table in the index at all and is REFUSED rather than guessed at. OVERRULE: Supply the table in the map's resolved_key; the display form will not be promoted to executable here.
